description: Readable oxlint ratchet — findings of `@pyreon/lint/oxlint/readable.json` (via scripts/oxlint-readable.jsonc) per (file, rule) may only DECREASE, and a file not listed here must have none. Checked by `bun scripts/check-readable-oxlint-ratchet.ts` (validate-fast + CI). Split the function, or fix with `bunx oxlint -c scripts/oxlint-readable.jsonc --fix <file>` for curly / newline-after-import / else-return; then tighten with `--update`. Never raise a count to absorb a finding.
